title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You'll own a portfolio of our most strategic accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC

* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
**Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!**
**Who Are We?**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!**
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
**In this role, You will..**
**Be Responsible For The Following**
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In This Position Your Main Mission Will Be**

* Engineering mission and leadership:

+ Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
+ As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.

* Platform Engineering:

+ Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
+ Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
+ Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
+ Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.

* Architecture and industrialization:

+ Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
+ Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team

* End-to-end delivery:

+ Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
+ Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.

* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:

+ Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
+ Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

**What are we looking for?**

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills

+ Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
+ Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
+ DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
+ Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
+ Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
+ Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
+ MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)

* Leadership style

+ Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
+ Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense

This is an individual contributor architecture role. Its authority comes from design quality, evidence and adoption rather than from line management.

* Own the AI infrastructure reference architecture and the standards that govern training, fine-tuning, inference and retrieval-augmented patterns across public cloud and private AI hosting.
* Define the standard AI workload intake pattern, including architecture review criteria, data classification handling, environment selection and the conditions under which a use case may go to production.
* Set guardrails for sensitive data, model access, prompt and inference logging, monitoring, resilience, retention and cost, in partnership with Security, Data Privacy and Quality.
* Design GPU and accelerator capacity patterns - shared pools, reservations, scheduling, quotas and burst to cloud - and support the associated capacity and cost models.
* Support qualification of AI platforms, regions and services for enterprise consumption together with AI & HPC Engineering and the public cloud architects.
* Define the MLOps and LLMOps reference chain: model registry, versioning, evaluation, deployment, drift and performance monitoring, and decommissioning.
* Maintain architecture decision records for AI platform choices, linking each to business value, risk posture and total cost of ownership.
* Advise business, research and Infrastructure Solution Delivery stakeholders on feasible AI infrastructure options, and translate scientific and commercial requirements into technical designs.
* Track the AI infrastructure market, evaluate emerging accelerators, model-serving stacks and platform services, and bring credible innovation into the roadmap.
* Coach engineers and architects on AI infrastructure practice and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.

**Essential Requirement**

* 8+ years' experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform architecture, with a strong track record of designing and supporting enterprise-scale technology solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in building, deploying, and operating AI and machine learning infrastructure within production environments.
* Experience enabling AI solutions to transition from proof-of-concept stages into scalable, governed, and business-critical services.
* Strong knowledge of GPU and accelerator technologies, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-based AI platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Hands-on experience with model serving, inference optimization, MLOps/LLMOps practices, and modern data and vector pipeline architectures.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, observability, cost optimization (FinOps), and secure AI platform operations.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, including explainability, auditability, logging, human oversight, and risk management controls.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI infrastructure concepts to technical and non-technical audiences while driving collaboration across engineering, security, privacy, and business teams.

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
description:
**Description**
Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?
  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
* Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
* Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

A day in the life
  
  
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries.
  
  
**About The Team**
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.
  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering - AI Platform
description:
We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast-growing, high-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features.
  
  
The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs.
  
  
You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedback
* Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
* Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
* Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

**Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
* Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
* Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
* Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

**What We Value**
**Ownership and independence**
You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.
  
  
**Management experience**
You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.
  
  
**Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering**
You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.
  
  
**Communication clarity**
You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.
  
  
**Result orientation and a growth mindset**
You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's.
  
  
**Distributed team experience and empathy**
Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus.
  
  
**Structured thinking in ambiguous situations**
AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision.
  
  
**Collaborative by default**
You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.
* Help write PRDs, specs, acceptance criteria, and release checklists for priority initiatives.
* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.
* Design and document prompts, agents, and SOPs for research, writing, analysis, QA, and reporting.
* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.
* Available full-time (or near full-time) for 3–6 months; based anywhere in India (IST or a similar timezone).

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.
* Personal projects, campus clubs, or research where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.
* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.
* Fintech, consumer apps, or personal-finance curiosity.
* Design fluency (Figma/Canva) or light engineering fluency.

Why join us
  
  
You will work directly with founders at an early-stage fintech building AI-native money products: rare exposure for an internship.
  
  
You will learn how strategy, product, data, and operations connect in practice, not in a textbook.
  
  
High performers will leave with a portfolio of real decisions influenced, workflows built, and outcomes shipped, and a strong path to a full-time conversation if there is mutual fit.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Darwinbox is Asia’s fastest growing SaaS based HR Technology platform. A brainchild of alumni from the country’s most distinguished institutions (IIT/IIM/XLRI) and organizations (McKinsey, EY, Google), Darwinbox is the preferred technology partner of 1000+ global enterprises with more than 4 million+ employees using the platform.
  
  
Our end-to-end HCM technology suite competes with the best in the business and has won against giants such as SAP, Oracle and Workday several times to acquire iconic enterprise customers ranging from the largest conglomerates to unicorns, such as, Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, Nivea, Puma, Swiggy, Paytm, Bigbasket and Delhivery.
  
  
Backed by Sequoia, Microsoft, KKR and Partners Group, and recognized by global analysts such as Gartner and Forrester, we are scaling rapidly across markets. This is a rocketship, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a GTM Engineer, you will embed across Marketing, SDRs, Sales, and Pre-Sales — mapping how work actually gets done, then engineering better versions of those workflows using AI. You will lead AI and technology implementation across all marketing functions, enabling the team to move faster, produce more, and make smarter decisions.
  
  
This is an AI-first role in the truest sense. You will not just use AI tools — you will build them. You will design systems, automate workflows, prototype internal tooling, and deploy solutions that generate compounding returns for the entire GTM engine.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* AI-Native Workflow Engineering
* Identify high-friction workflows across the GTM org and rebuild them with AI at the core.
* Build and deploy automation pipelines using n8n, Make, Clay, and LLM APIs — replacing manual effort with intelligent, signal-driven systems.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build internal tools, scripts, and dashboards without engineering dependencies. If the tool you need does not exist, build it yourself.
* AI-Powered Content & Demand Generation
* Build a content automation pipeline for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — so Darwinbox surfaces in every relevant AI-driven buyer conversation, at scale.
* Design and deploy AI-powered outbound systems that personalize messaging at the account and persona level, replacing manual sequencing with intelligent, signal-driven outreach.
* Experiment with warm-up sequences, inbox health, deliverability, and multi-channel orchestration across email and LinkedIn.
* MarTech Stack & AI Tool Ownership
* Own the evaluation, onboarding, and integration of AI and MarTech tools: HubSpot, Clay, Apollo.io, Cognism, HeyReach, Instantly, and whatever emerges next.
* Audit tech spend, eliminate redundancy, and optimize for leverage. If a new AI tool could make the team 2x more effective, you are testing it that week — not that quarter.
* Reporting, Analytics & Data Intelligence
* Build real-time dashboards for campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and GTM efficiency.
* Analyze funnel metrics and surface actionable insights using SQL, automation, or whatever tool fits the question.
* Automate CRM hygiene, data enrichment, and reporting workflows, so the team always works with clean, reliable data.
* Process Design & Governance
* Map existing GTM processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement automation for speed and accuracy.
* Document all workflows and maintain a system of record for automation. Ensure compliance with data governance standards.

**Who Should Apply**

* AI builder: You build with AI, not just prompt it.
* You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot to ship real things: tools, automations, dashboards, scripts. Going from a problem statement to a working prototype without filing an engineering ticket is table stakes.
* Hands-on experience with automation and integration tools: n8n, Clay, Make, Zapier, or similar.
* Comfort with SQL and APIs — enough to pull, transform, and load data independently.
* Engineering rigor: you break ambiguous problems into first-principles components and own them end-to-end.
* Obsession with outcomes. You are not done when it is built — you are done when it is measurably working.
* Graduated from a top-tier institution (think IIT, NIT, BITS, or equivalent).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2-6 years in content marketing for B2B / SaaS (HR tech experience is a plus).
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities.
* Experience with content calendars, editorial planning, and project workflows.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and performance analytics.
* Strong understanding of buyer personas, content funnels, and GTM alignment.

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
We're looking for a highly accomplished and Senior Technical Consultant with 5+ years of experience to lead the charge on complex AI agentic deployments. This role demands a seasoned technologist and strategic partner who can not only design and develop bespoke solutions leveraging our Agentforce platform and other cutting-edge technologies but also lead technical engagements and mentor junior peers. You'll be the primary driver of transformative AI solutions, operating with deep technical mastery, unparalleled problem-solving prowess, and a relentless focus on delivering tangible value in dynamic, real-world environments, from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimization.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Consultant, you'll be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI solutions to our most strategic clients. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond. You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation: Be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of complex AI solutions, personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues, while also guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.
* Build Transformative AI Solutions: Take primary ownership of designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.
* Engineer Bespoke Agentic AI Solutions: Work directly with customers to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Agentforce platform, ensuring they precisely meet unique business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing customer ecosystems.
* Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimized, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.
* Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, from intricate data integration to sophisticated model deployment and advanced agent orchestration. You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.
* Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become a foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, pushing its capabilities to the limit. You'll lead the development of bespoke intelligent agents, automate intricate business processes, and craft intuitive user experiences. Your insights from the field will directly influence future product enhancements and help shape the strategic direction of our platform, often representing the voice of the customer in product discussions.
* Become a Trusted Strategic Partner: Embed yourself deeply with client teams to truly grasp their operational challenges and strategic goals. You'll translate these nuanced needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and solution designs, building strong relationships as their primary technical advisor and leading technical discussions.
* Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.
* Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelize engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment
* Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with Agentforce, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks
* Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development
* Demonstrated entrepreneurship, a "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects
* Ability to travel upto 60% of the time, as needed to customer sites

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Extensive experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform
* Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions within highly regulated industries
* Expert-level experience with Apex and LWC coding languages in a professional setting
* Prior experience in a customer-facing, hands-on technical lead or architect role

*be your best*

title: AI Test Architect
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
We’re looking for an
**AI Test Architect**
to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the
**test architecture strategy**
end-to-end—combining
**LLM-driven automation**
,
**computer vision**
, and
**hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems**
—to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for
**mobile applications and hardware-integrated products**
.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you’ll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* AI Test Strategy & Architecture
* Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers.
* Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve.
* Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements.
* Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks.
* AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
* Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs.
* Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts.
* Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis.
* Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors.
* Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI.
* Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
* Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e.g., medical devices, sensors, wearables).
* Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale.
* Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time.
* Partner with mobile teams (Android/iOS) to integrate Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/FlaUI where appropriate and augment with AI components.
* On-Prem Infrastructure & MLOps for Test at Scale
* Design on-prem/private-cloud inference infrastructure for low-latency, high-throughput model execution with strong data privacy guarantees.
* Containerize models and agents (Docker) and integrate into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for parallel execution and test-on-commit workflows.
* Implement continuous learning loops to leverage test failures, telemetry, and labels to retrain and improve models.
* Establish model lifecycle practices (versioning, evaluation, rollback, governance) using tools like MLflow/Langchain, self-hosted vector stores, and caching.
* Automation Platforms & Tooling
* Extend or replace traditional frameworks (e.g., Appium) with AI-assisted components that enhance stability and coverage.
* Build Python-based toolchains for model training/inference and integrations into test workflows; standardize reusable libraries and templates.

**About The Role**
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
  
  
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
  
  
**As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will**

* Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
* Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
* Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
* Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
* Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
* Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
* Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
* Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
* Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
* Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
* Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
* Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
* Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

**flexible workplace**

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. **What You’ll Be Doing…**
As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.
  
  

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

You will own the complete solution lifecycle—from direct client discovery and architectural design to hands-on implementation and production deployment—translating complex, ambiguous business problems into secure, high-performance Cloud AI systems.

Proven track record building enterprise microservices, REST APIs, and distributed event-driven applications.

Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) core services: Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.

Practical experience designing agentic AI workflows and establishing automated evaluation metrics (“evals”) for enterprise AI applications.

Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a track record of optimizing application performance.
  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, Healthcare, Enterprise SaaS) with strict security and compliance considerations.
  
  
Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-optimization strategies for large-scale GenAI workloads.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & System Design: Architect and implement resilient, scalable, and high-throughput enterprise systems and microservices using GCP-native cloud frameworks.
  
  
GenAI & Agentic Engineering: Build and deploy enterprise GenAI applications leveraging Vertex AI, Gemini API, Vertex AI Vector Search, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Establish automated evaluation loops (“evals”) to measure model performance, drift, and accuracy.
  
  
Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Lead end-to-end delivery—including technical requirement gathering, architectural blueprints, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), production integration, deployment, and performance optimization.
  
  
Cloud & DevOps Orchestration: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and manage containerized microservices across Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the technical authority in direct client engagements, translating business requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps and conducting technical deep dives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guide engineering teams through design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, establish best practices, and drive technical excellence across cross-functional initiatives.

We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Data Engineering Manager – Product Forward Deployed Engineer**
**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.
  
  
ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.
  
  
We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte’s next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. The ideal candidate will have exceptional SQL and Python skills, expertise in Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and ability to convey complex data, concepts, and ideas in succinct, clear fashion to various business stakeholders. Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset is preferred.
  
  

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team
* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies
* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks
* Deploy advanced use of both SQL and Python coding languages in analyzing large data sets

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to the AVP – Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) and works at the intersection of data, product, and client delivery. Partners with US-based product and portfolio leaders to translate client needs into scalable data solutions, leveraging and validating complex datasets to generate actionable insights. Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 10-14 years of relevant consulting experience (or equivalent) with a focus on storytelling and building Model Ready Datasets (MRD) based on analysis of large external and client data sets
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.
* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.
* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements
* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.
* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team
* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies
* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks
* Advanced user of both SQL and Python coding languages with experience in analyzing large data sets

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a related field.
* Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset.
* Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment patterns.
* Knowledge of data engineering best practices and methodologies.
* Knowledge of feature engineering and practical experience working with data scientists on enabling production feature engineering pipelines at scale.
* Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced development environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Data Quality, EDA, MRD generation & Governance Ownership
* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and External Vendors
* Vendor & External Dataset Management
* Technical Depth in SQL, Python, and Cloud Data Warehousing (GCP/BigQuery)
* Technical Leadership & Team Coaching
* Clear Communication of Complex Data to Business Stakeholders

**Why This Role Matters**
Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. They apply data and AI/ML capabilities to deliver scalable solutions, translate client learnings back into the product, and shape how Converge Consumer turns data into better decisions. It’s a hands-on path to becoming a leader at the intersection of product, data, and client impact.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.

* Experience with AI workflows and automation.

* Experience in UI Path Platform and UIPath Agent Builder background

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
